name: Research, Verification & Black World Intelligence
buyer_problem: A subject, claim, or history needs source review, reconstruction, verification, or serious Black World context.
engagement_model: The question, evidence standard, audience, and intended public use determine the research and communication path.
format_rule: Briefs, reports, memos, dossiers, and audits are delivery formats inside an engagement. They are not a primary product ladder.
representation_note: This is a descriptive public engagement path. It does not expose a briefing-to-memo product ladder or autonomous action endpoint.
